title: Remove map page, apply yellow borders to all pages, update navigation and footer

requirements.summary: Remove the Map page entirely from the application
acceptanceCriteria: No map route exists in App.tsx
No map link appears in the header or section navigator
Navigating to the old map URL returns a 404 or redirects to home

file_operations.description: Delete the MapMode.tsx page component file entirely
Remove the /map route definition and its lazy import from the router configuration
Remove the Map navigation link from the desktop navigation menu
Remove the Map section entry from the sections array in the full-screen navigation overlay

requirements.summary: Apply consistent yellow borders to all card/panel containers across the application
acceptanceCriteria: Every card, panel, or windowed container on every page has a visible yellow border
The yellow border color is consistent and uses the QMY brand yellow defined in tailwind.config.js
The global glass-card utility class in index.css is updated to include the yellow border so all components using it inherit it automatically
ProfileGlassPanel, wallet cards, DAO cards, bank tiles, presale cards, and all other container components display yellow borders

Add yellow border classes to the chat message container and input form card

Add yellow border classes to the transaction history card wrapper

requirements.summary: Update navigation to include all active pages and remove Map link
acceptanceCriteria: The Map link is removed from the header navigation
All active application pages are accessible from the header or section navigator
No broken or dead navigation links exist

file_operations.description: Remove the Map link from the desktop navigation array and ensure all other active pages (Home, QMY Token, Wallet, AR Profile, Bank, DAO, Chat, Docs, Presale, About, Legal, Contact) are present and correctly linked
Remove the Map section from the sections array and verify that all other active application pages are listed with correct routes, availability badges, and no broken links

requirements.summary: Remove all Caffeine references from the footer
acceptanceCriteria: The word 'Caffeine' does not appear anywhere in the rendered footer
No links to Caffeine domains appear in the footer
Footer retains Quantumoney logo, tagline, and navigation columns

file_operations.description: Remove all references to 'Caffeine' from the footer text, links, and branding while retaining the Quantumoney logo, tagline, and all navigation column links (Resources, Governance, Legal)
